components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one brand-filled action per view. Pill, 40px, verb + object label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-brand, #0066cc); color: #fff; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 15px/1 Vazirmatn, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 100ms cubic-bezier(0.28,0.11,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-brand-hover, #005bbb); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand, #0066cc); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action: white fill, hairline stroke, same pill and height.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: var(--color-ink, #1d1d1f); height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14); border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 15px/1 Vazirmatn, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 100ms cubic-bezier(0.28,0.11,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-canvas-alt, #f5f5f7); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand, #0066cc); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Label above, 12px radius, 16%-alpha stroke, blue ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: Vazirmatn, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #1d1d1f); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.16); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; font: 400 15px/1 inherit; color: inherit; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 0; border-color: var(--color-brand, #0066cc); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(0 102 204 / 0.25); }

components.name: Card
components.description: 18px surface on a hairline crease with the low shadow; no nested cards.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); border-radius: 18px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04); font-family: Vazirmatn, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #1d1d1f); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 700 15px/1.2 Estedad, Vazirmatn, sans-serif; } .ds-card-figure { margin: 0; font: 700 28px/1.2 Vazirmatn, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-unit { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #6e6e73); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: The single status→tone→label map: pill, muted ground, dot in the semantic tone.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-canvas-alt, #f5f5f7); font: 500 12px/1 Vazirmatn, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #1d1d1f); } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-badge--success { color: var(--color-success, #0f7b3f); background: rgb(15 123 63 / 0.10); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: 44px pill row; active = 10% blue ground, blue semibold text, icon at the reading end.
components.html: داشبوردفروش و صندوق
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 240px; font-family: Vazirmatn, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--color-ink, #1d1d1f); text-decoration: none; font-size: 15px; transition: background 100ms cubic-bezier(0.28,0.11,0.32,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-canvas-alt, #f5f5f7); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: rgb(0 102 204 / 0.10); color: var(--color-brand, #0066cc); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand, #0066cc); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A phone-shop till that stays out of the way. The interface is near-monochrome — white and warm-grey grounds, near-black ink, one blue — with whitespace doing the structuring that lines and colour usually do. Colour is information: blue means you can act on this, and the three semantic tones mean money or work state; nothing else is coloured. Actions are pills, surfaces are soft 18px cards on hairline creases, shadows are almost colourless.
keyCharacteristics: Two alternating grounds (white / #f5f5f7) separate sections — never borders
One accent, brand #0066cc, on ≤10% of any screen; semantics carry meaning only
Hairline borders at 8% alpha, three near-colourless shadow steps
Persian-first type: Estedad display, Vazirmatn body, 17px/1.65, tabular figures
RTL from the root; logical properties only; three digit modes

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: There is no second accent. Secondary actions are neutral-filled or outlined; charts use the blue plus greys and the semantic three.

rules.name: The Paper Island Rule
rules.body: A print sheet is ink on white in both themes; every semantic token restores to its -on-light step inside [data-paper].

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Colour carries meaning, not decoration: blue = actionable, green/amber/red = money or work state, yellow = a price tag.

rules.name: The Three Digits Rule
rules.body: Prose uses Persian digits; tables use Latin tabular digits; IMEI, phone and serial are Latin, LTR-isolated and ungrouped.

rules.name: The No SF Pro Rule
rules.body: Only self-hosted, licensed Persian faces ship.

rules.name: The Ground First Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs a shadow to be seen, its ground is wrong.

dos: Do alternate white and #f5f5f7 grounds to separate sections; keep borders for tables and cards only.
Do keep one brand fill per view and render every status through StatusBadge.
Do use Money, Num, JDatePicker, DataTable, FilterBar, PageHeader, EmptyState rather than page-local markup.
Do keep touch targets at 40px and register rows keyboard-reachable.
Do restore semantic tokens to their light step inside [data-paper].
donts: Don't introduce a second accent, a gradient, or glass outside the nav and sidebar.
Don't use physical direction classes or mirror ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.
Don't hardcode a hex, a size, a z-index or a duration; every value is a token.
Don't use Tailwind's shadow-md/shadow-lg or a ring as an edge.
Don't fake a print sheet with bg-white text-black.
